thread:
maria_cs: Hey team — kickoff handoff for PrimeBridge private/VPC. Quick status: networking done from their side (subnets, TGWs), but they hit two blockers: KMS key access for the inference nodes and audit log forwarding to their Splunk collector. Also flagged potential renewal risk if we can’t get audit retention confirmed by EOD.
ajay_se: Thanks Maria. Can you paste the exact error they're seeing with KMS when the agent tries to decrypt tokens? that'll help.
maria_cs: They sent: `AccessDeniedException: Caller is not authorized to use this CMK for decryption` when the deploy agent hits the /v1/secrets/decrypt call. Happening on both staging and dev accounts.
leo_kms: Most likely KMS key policy or grant missing. Ask if they're using a customer-managed key in their account vs our cross-account key. If cross-account key, we need to add their account principal in the key policy and create a Grant for 'Encrypt/Decrypt' for the Redwood service principal.
sam_infra: Also confirm the EC2/IAM role attached to the inference nodes includes kms:Decrypt in its inline policy. Common miss is only allowing DescribeKey or ListKeys but not Decrypt.
maria_cs: I asked for their role ARN and they replied with `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/primebridge-inference`. Sharing what I sent them to try next:

```
# ask them to attach this policy to the instance role
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333444:key/abcd-1234-ef56-7890"
    }
  ]
}
```

maria_cs: I also pasted a suggested key policy snippet for the CMK (they own the key):

```
{"Sid":"AllowRedwoodSvcDecrypt","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-service-role"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}
```

ajay_se: Good. For audit logs: are they using CloudTrail to S3 + Splunk HF forwarder? If so we need the S3 bucket ACLs and Kinesis/Firehose IAM role set properly. What retention do they need to avoid renewal risk?
maria_cs: They said 2 years retention, but compliance asked for proof that logs are immutable and will be retained for 730 days. Their security lead wants the S3 bucket policy and lifecycle rule confirmed before Friday.
sam_infra: Action items: (1) Leo, confirm the CMK policy/Grant steps and produce an explicit checklist. (2) Ajay, share the S3 + Firehose minimal roles and a sample bucket policy. (3) Maria/CS -> schedule a 30m call with their security lead tomorrow 11:00 ET. I'll join.
leo_kms: Will do. Short checklist draft:
- Confirm key ARN and owning AWS account
- Add Redwood cross-account principal to key policy (if cross-account)
- Create a Grant for Encrypt/Decrypt for the service role
- Verify node IAM role includes kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey
- Test decrypt with aws kms decrypt CLI and capture output

ajay_se: Sample S3 bucket policy (to be adjusted for their account/bucket):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/firehose-deliver-role"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::primebridge-audit/*"}
  ]
}
```

maria_cs: I pushed both snippets to their thread. They responded that Firehose IAM role exists but doesn't have PutObject ACL for object ownership and they can't confirm bucket versioning is enabled.
ajay_se: That explains immutability concern — enable versioning + object lock if they need WORM. If they enable Object Lock, policy implications for lifecycle rules and the ability to delete objects change — we'll note that for cutover.
maria_cs: Renewal risk note for CS tracker: if audit retention and KMS access not validated by Friday, customer flagged as 'at risk' for the renewal playbook. I'll mark the account and start escalations if no progress by EOD Friday.

sam_infra: Quick troubleshooting tip for them to test KMS locally:
```
aws kms encrypt --key-id <key-arn> --plaintext "hello" --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode | aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb:///dev/stdin
```
If decrypt fails, capture the full IAM error (request ID) and paste it.
```

deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly onboard checklist for PrimeBridge is due in 2 days — assign all outstanding items to owners. :robot_face:
maria_cs: Thanks — I'll book the security call and follow up with a runbook and the CS renewal flag update post-call. Please drop any short clarifications here so I can include them in the runbook. :thumbsup:
